channel.description: Updates for Rift — review, blame & verify AI-generated code from Coursion.

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
First public release of Rift — a native macOS cockpit for reviewing, blaming, and verifying AI-generated code.

  • Agent panel with drag-and-drop file context, paste-as-attachment, and @-mentions
  • Per-line origin (blame) and agent-session attribution in the Inspector
  • On-device risk triage on staged diffs, with deep Claude review on demand
  • Monaco-backed editor, diffs, and inline staging
  • PR review threads alongside the code
  • Hardened against untrusted-repo git config execution
